tree.label: Courses and files in {{semester}}
tree.failed: Couldn't load these files. Press Enter to try again.

filter.label: Filter by tag
filter.full: A filter can have up to {{count, number}} tags.
filter.capped: Showing the first {{count, number}} matching files.

list.label: Files in {{semester}}
list.labelFiltered: Files in {{semester}} with the selected tags

noSemesters.title: No semesters yet
noSemesters.text: Add a semester to hold your courses. Folio makes a folder for it in your library.

noCourses.title: No courses in {{semester}}
noCourses.text: Add the courses you're taking. Folio makes a folder for each one inside {{semester}}.
noCourses.hint: Or switch semesters in the menu above.

noMatch.title: No files match
noMatch.textOne: No file in {{semester}} has the tag {{tag}}.
noMatch.textMany: No file in {{semester}} has {{tags}}. A filter with several tags shows files that have all of them.

noFiles.title: No files in {{semester}} yet
noFiles.text: Files you add to its courses show up here.

reading.title: Reading your library…
reading.text: Courses show up here as Folio finds them.

readOnly.title: Read-only for now.
readOnly.text: A newer version of Folio changed this library's settings. You can browse and search; update Folio to change tags and courses.

rebuild.title: Rebuilding the search index.
rebuild.text: Some files may be missing from search until it finishes. Changes are paused.

recovered.title: Folio rebuilt its index for this library.
recovered.text: Your files and tags are safe. Search may miss some files until the scan finishes.

empty.title: Select a file to preview
empty.text: Or drop files here to add them to the current course

start.title: Add courses to get started
start.text: Then drop files here to add them to a course.

emptyCourse.title: {{name}} has no files yet
emptyCourse.text: Drop files here to add them, or choose Add files. They're copied into {{name}}; the originals stay where they are.

emptyFolder.title: {{name}} is empty
emptyFolder.text: Drop files here to add them, or choose Add files. They're copied into {{name}}; the originals stay where they are.

recentEmpty.title: Nothing added to {{semester}} in the last 7 days
recentEmpty.text: Files you add or save into the library show up here for a week.

untaggedEmpty.title: Every file in {{semester}} has a tag
untaggedEmpty.text: Files without tags show up here.

menu.label: Actions for {{name}}
menu.readOnlyTags: Tags can't change until you update Folio

errors.NameTrailingDotOrSpace: A name can't end with a dot or a space.
errors.NameReserved: Windows reserves this name, like CON or NUL. Choose another.
errors.NameTooLong: This name is too long. Use 255 characters or fewer.
errors.PathTooLong: The full path would be too long for Windows. Use a shorter name.
errors.AlreadyExists: There's already an item called “{{name}}” in {{folder}}.
errors.InUse: Another app is using this file. Close it there, then try again.
errors.ReadOnly: A newer version of Folio made this library's settings read-only, and this item's tags would have to move. Update Folio to rename it.

extension.title: Change the extension to .{{extension}}?
extension.text: {{name}} might open in a different app, or not at all.

move.title: Move {{name}}
move.invalid: A folder can't go inside itself or one of its folders.

delete.doneSeveral: Moved {{count, number}} items to the Recycle Bin

course.title: Delete {{name}}?
course.text_one: The course folder “{{folder}}” and its {{count, number}} file go to the Recycle Bin. You can restore them from there.
course.text_other: The course folder “{{folder}}” and its {{count, number}} files go to the Recycle Bin. You can restore them from there.
course.kept: Its code, colour and tags stay in Folio, so they come back if you restore the folder.

semester.title: Delete {{name}}?
semester.text_one: The semester folder and its {{courses}} with {{count, number}} file go to the Recycle Bin. You can restore them from there.
semester.text_other: The semester folder and its {{courses}} with {{count, number}} files go to the Recycle Bin. You can restore them from there.
semester.kept: Course codes, colours and tags stay in Folio, so they come back if you restore the folder.

items.title: Delete {{count, number}} items?
items.text: They go to the Recycle Bin, course folders with everything in them. You can restore them from there.
items.kept: Course codes, colours and tags stay in Folio, so they come back if you restore the folders.

reasons.InUse: Another app is using it or something in it.
reasons.NotRecyclable: Folio couldn't move it to the Recycle Bin. The drive may not have one, or the path is too long for it. Folio never deletes files for good.

tags.partial: Changed the tags of {{done, number}} of {{total, number}} items

open.editorText: Folio doesn't run programs or scripts, so it opened this one for editing.
open.blockedText: To keep you safe, it won't run {{name}}. Show it in File Explorer if you want to open it yourself.

selection.tooMany: Folio can change up to {{count, number}} items at once. Select fewer and try again.
